event: Geometry worker reported that its combined lease-check/write command continued after the old lease expired. Only assigned new geometry files were written.
response: All workers stopped; reviewer confirmed no writes or jobs, renderer had finished with no Blender process. Parent explicitly released old lease and claimed a fresh lease before continuing.
verification: Parent checked the fresh lease successfully and reran build.py. Regeneration exited zero and reproduced the identical candidate hash. Tracked base files remain unchanged.
followUp: Lease checks must terminate the command on nonzero status before any subsequent mutation. This record does not retrospectively authorize the expired-lease write.
